BASICDOS-360K:
REM BASIC-DOS release diskette configuration
SESSIONS=3
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES"
BASICDOS-360K-S80:
REM Demonstration of a single-console configuration
SESSIONS=3
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":HELLO.BAT
BASICDOS-360K-D40:
REM Demonstration of two 40-column consoles
SESSIONS=4
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":COLOR 7,1:HELLO.BAT
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
REM CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":PIPES.BAT
BASICDOS-360K-D80:
REM Demonstration of two 80-column consoles
REM SESSIONS=2
CON=VKD$:80,16,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES"
CON=VKD$:80,9,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES"
BASICDOS-360K-P80:
REM Demonstration of Multiple Video Pages, on video pages 0, 1, and 2
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":HELLO.BAT
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":FIBO.BAT
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-P80PM:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) in protected mode
CPU=80286
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-PM386:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) in protected mode on an 80386
CPU=80386
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-DUAL:
REM Demonstration of dual monitors with full-screen consoles
SESSIONS=4
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,25,0,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS":IF EXISTS("C:\SRC") THEN PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\TOOLS\BIN":C: :CD SRC :MK :ELSE PIPES.BAT
BASICDOS-360K-MULTI:
REM Demonstration of dual monitors with multiple consoles per monitor
SESSIONS=8
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":FIBO.BAT
CON=VKD$:40,25,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":PRIMES.BAS
CON=VKD$:80,15,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":COLOR 7,1:PIPES.BAT
CON=VKD$:80,10,1,1
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES":HELLO.BAT
BASICDOS-360K-SERIAL:
REM Local and serial displays, using shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,GENERIC
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-VT100:
REM Local display and VT100 terminal, with shells on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-DEBUG:
REM Local console, with the serial debugger exclusively on COM2
DEVICE=EXT\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES"
BASICDOS-360K-M64:
REM 64K demonstration with one session and no PIPE$ driver
REM FPU$ and PIPE$ (at 64K) and drivers for missing hardware skip themselves
BUFFERS=2
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES"
BASICDOS-360K-M640:
REM 640K demonstration with one console, with its shell on the hard disk
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-TERM:
REM 64K demonstration with no video: one console on a VT100 connected to COM1
REM FPU$ and PIPE$ (at 64K) and drivers for missing hardware skip themselves
SKIP=VKD$
BUFFERS=2
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="A:\;A:\EXT;A:\DEMOS;A:\SAMPLES"
BASICDOS-360K-TERMHD:
REM No video: one console on a VT100 connected to COM1, with its shell on the hard disk
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-TERM2:
REM No video: two consoles, on VT100s connected to COM1 and COM2, with shells on the hard disk
SKIP=VKD$
CON=COM1:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
CON=COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN"
BASICDOS-360K-MMU:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) in protected mode, with DEBUG.COM on COM2
CPU=80286
DEVICE=EXT\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-360K-MMU386:
REM Multiple Video Pages (0, 1, and 2) in protected mode on an 80386, with DEBUG.COM on COM2
CPU=80386
DEVICE=EXT\DEBUG.COM COM2:9600,N,8,1,VT100
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":FIBO.BAT
SHELL=C:COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":PRIMES.BAS
BASICDOS-10MB:
REM Single 80x25 console on a hard disk
SHELL=COMMAND.COM PATH$="C:\;C:\EXT;C:\DEMOS;C:\SAMPLES;C:\TOOLS\BIN":HELLO.BAT
